title: 安田記念の後に・名を呼んで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The venue goes wild for King Halo as she achieves another stunning victory in the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her overwhelming skill at sprints brings wonderful results as she continues down her path to becoming her own first-rate Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She faces her fans with a big smile and announces her next objective: the autumn G1 Sprinters Stakes.
